text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year, Trainer! I hope you
have a
good one.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
At the start of the new year, Фудзи Кисэки
stops by
to give her holiday greetings.
choice_data_list: Happy New Year to you too.

text_block_list.text: Now, then...
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I'm sure you'll be doing a lot for me this
year, so I
prepared a heartfelt gift to
thank you in advance.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Do you have any idea what it might be?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки
choice_data_list: I can't even begin to guess.

text_block_list.text:
My gift to you is some heart-pounding

excitement!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Let the New Year's talent show begin!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Sorry for springing this on you,
but it's a
special day, and I want you to
enjoy it.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I've already readied a line-up of
performances, so
just choose what you'd
like to see!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Фудзи Кисэки presents me with a list of
three
different options.
choice_data_list: A show of dexterous umbrella juggling.

text_block_list.text:
The Монолог, is it? Gotcha! I used to
recite this
one all the time as a kid!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Inhale... Exhale...
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
"To be, or not to be, that is the
question: whether
'tis nobler in the mind
to suffer..."
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
"To die, to sleep no more; and by a
sleep, to say
we end the heartache..."
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Though she's reciting a well-known
Монолог,
she packs it with a level of
nuance that makes it
feel fresh.

"To sleep, perchance to dream; aye,
there's the
rub, for in that sleep of
death, what dreams may
come..."
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Her performance is so impressive, I start
clapping
and cheering the moment she
finishes.
Roger! Things are about to get flashy!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Hit it!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
At her prompt, "Make Debut!" starts
playing from
somewhere.
Hup! Hah!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
She begins to do cartwheels and
somersaults and
puts on a dazzling
acrobatic show!
Huff... Huff! How was that?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Фудзи Кисэки's new choreography totally

transformed the mood of the song.
Ahaha! I'm glad you enjoyed it.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Okay! Umbrella juggling it is.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
The umbrella juggling show Фудзи Кисэки
puts on for
me is exquisite beyond
words!
Ah, ah, ah! Phew! That was close!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
The umbrellas tip precariously on her
palms, but
she never lets them fall.
They're as light as
sunbeams in her
hands.
Hah!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
For the last act, she propels a ball high,
high,
high into the air from the parasol's
rim and
catches it neatly with a grin!
Hehe. Thank you for your patronage.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Seeing you this delighted makes
me want
to thank my younger self for all
her tireless
practice!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Maybe I should get some of my dorm
residents to
join me and choreograph a
version for eighteen
people next time!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Фудзи Кисэки, I have a
wonderfully fun
New Year's Day.

I'm sure this year will be one filled with
victories.
I'm ready to work hard with her
and take her to
the top!
